# Milestone 5 — Sensei (AI) (plan, 2026-09-23)

## Context

School requirement: an AI feature. Handoff « Le Sensei (IA) »: two exact uses,
never a chatbot. (1) A contextual explanation after a quiz mistake, unfolded
by the « Pourquoi ? » link under the vermillion feedback (screens 09–12).
(2) Context after a tile scan, streamed into the result sheet (screens 15–16).
Tile identification itself also moves from the hash fake to the model
(`TileIdentifier` interface unchanged). Firebase AI Logic (`firebase_ai`),
protected by the App Check already active in `main.dart`; no API key ships in
the app (CLAUDE.md §3).

Decisions (brainstorming, 2026-09-23, user):
- **Backend: Gemini Developer API** (`FirebaseAI.googleAI()`), free tier on the
  Spark plan; not Vertex / Agent Platform (Blaze).
- **Scanner: two calls.** Call 1 photo → JSON `{code}` (structured output),
  the sheet opens with the tile at once. Call 2 text-only, streams the context
  into the Sensei panel. A failed call 2 never hides the tile.
- **Offline: no new dependency.** The « Pourquoi ? » link stays active; a
  network-class failure shows the offline note in the panel (no
  « Réessayer »). Deviation: the link is not pre-dimmed as on screen 12.
- **Placement: `lib/sensei/`**, own flat feature folder; learning and scanner
  import it.
- Model name in one place (`AppConfig.senseiModel`): `gemini-3.8-flash`
  (docs default, 2026-09); fallback `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` (stable,
  confirmed free tier) if the console demands Blaze for Flash.

**Verified at Task 1 (2026-09-23, `firebase_ai-4.0.0/lib/src/`):**
- App Check: `FirebaseAI.googleAI({FirebaseApp? app, bool? useLimitedUseAppCheckTokens})`
  picks up `app.getService<FirebaseAppCheck>()` itself; the explicit
  `appCheck:` / `auth:` parameters are `@Deprecated` ("internal handling is
  now automatic"). So: `FirebaseAI.googleAI().generativeModel(...)`, nothing
  to pass. `vertexAI()` is deprecated in favour of `agentPlatform()`; not used.
- Model: `generativeModel({required String model, GenerationConfig? generationConfig, Content? systemInstruction, ...})`
  (`firebase_ai.dart:182`). `GenerationConfig({temperature, responseMimeType, responseSchema, ...})`
  (`api.dart:1328`). `generateContent(Iterable<Content>)` →
  `Future<GenerateContentResponse>`, `generateContentStream(Iterable<Content>)`
  → `Stream<GenerateContentResponse>`; `.text` is `String?` on both
  (`generative_model.dart:116,146`).
- Content: `Content.text(String)`, `Content.multi(Iterable<Part>)`,
  `Content.system(String)`, `TextPart(String)`,
  `InlineDataPart(String mimeType, Uint8List bytes)` (`content.dart:41-65,267`).
- Schema: `Schema.object({required Map<String, Schema> properties, ...})`,
  `Schema.enumString({required List<String> enumValues, ...})` (`schema.dart:41,129`).
- Errors: `FirebaseAIException` (base) with `InvalidApiKey`,
  `UnsupportedUserLocation`, `ServiceApiNotEnabled`, `QuotaExceeded`,
  `ServerException`; `FirebaseAISdkException` separate (`error.dart`).
  Server-side errors arrive as JSON `{error}` and are rethrown as one of
  these, on both the single and the streamed path (`api.dart:1489,1514`).
- **Network failure type:** the SDK uses `package:http` (`client.dart`);
  on Android `http 1.6.0` wraps a socket failure in
  `_ClientSocketException`, which `implements SocketException`
  (`http-1.6.0/lib/src/io_client.dart:27`). So `_isNetwork(e) => e is SocketException`
  from `dart:io` is enough; **no `package:http` import, no new dependency.**

Working mode unchanged: user writes `lib/`, Claude tutors/reviews, test-writer
writes tests, Claude does docs. One new dependency: `firebase_ai ^4.0.0`
(pre-approved by CLAUDE.md §1.10; dry-run resolves clean on Dart 3.13.3),
still named and confirmed before `flutter pub add` (Task 1).

Sensei visual identity (handoff): hanko seal 22×22 radius 6 `#B93531` with
**先** white; panel `senseiPanel` with a 3 px left rule in bamboo green,
radius 12 (`radiusSubPanel`); header « LE SENSEI » mono uppercase. States:
**loading** three green tiles 11×15 pulsing in a wave (translateY −5 px +
opacity 0.4→1, 1.2 s, delays 0/0.2/0.4 s) + label « Le sensei regarde votre
main » / « … la tuile »; **streaming** text grows, green block cursor 8×15
blinking (steps, 0.9 s) at the end; **failure** grey seal `#B5AC9F`, grey
rule, « L'explication n'est pas arrivée. Vous pouvez continuer sans elle. »,
discreet « Réessayer » (white, green text); **offline** « Hors ligne — les
explications du sensei reviendront avec la connexion. ». Never blocking:
« Continuer » stays active. Tone: patient teacher, explains why *this*
reasoning was wrong and why the right answer is better.

## Layout (flat feature folder, mirrors `lib/auth/` naming)

```
lib/sensei/sensei_request.dart             freezed sealed SenseiRequest: quizMiss(...) | tileContext(Tile)
lib/sensei/sensei_state.dart               freezed sealed SenseiState: idle | loading | streaming(String) | done(String) | failed | offline
lib/sensei/sensei_repository.dart          abstract SenseiRepository { Stream<String> explain(SenseiRequest request); }
lib/sensei/firebase_sensei_repository.dart FirebaseSenseiRepository(GenerativeModel): prompt per request, generateContentStream
lib/sensei/sensei_providers.dart           generativeModelProvider, senseiRepositoryProvider, senseiProvider (family, autoDispose)
lib/sensei/sensei_panel_widget.dart        SenseiPanelWidget(request:, autoStart:): seal, header, six states
lib/scanner/firebase_tile_identifier.dart  FirebaseTileIdentifier(GenerativeModel): photo → JSON {code} → Tile? (fake stays for tests)
```

Modified: `lib/app/app_config.dart` (`senseiModel`), `lib/shared/theme/app_tokens.dart`
+ `app_colors.dart` (tokens below), `lib/scanner/scanner_providers.dart`
(identifier swap), `lib/scanner/scanner_screen.dart` (`_ResultSheet` hosts the
panel), `lib/learning/lesson_screen.dart` (`_FeedbackSheet` miss branch: link +
panel), `pubspec.yaml` (dependency).

`SenseiRequest` is a freezed value so it can key a provider family
(`==`/`hashCode` generated) and be built by two features without either
knowing the prompt. `SenseiState` carries the cumulative text; the repository
streams chunks; the notifier concatenates.

## Data flow

```
Quiz miss:
  check() → _FeedbackSheet (miss) shows « Pourquoi ? » (TextButton, underlined, mutedStrong)
  tap → ref.read(senseiProvider(req).notifier).ask()
      req = SenseiRequest.quizMiss(question, hand, options, chosenIndex, correctIndex, feedback)
  ask(): if state is loading/streaming → return          (re-entrant tap ignored)
         state = loading
         sub = repository.explain(req).listen(
           (chunk) => state = streaming(text + chunk),
           onDone:  () => state = text.isEmpty ? failed : done(text),
           onError: (e, s) { debugPrint; state = _isNetwork(e) ? offline : failed; })
         ref.onDispose(sub.cancel)                        (leaving the block cancels the stream)
  « Continuer » enabled in every state → next block → new lessonId/blockIndex → different req →
  old family member disposed (autoDispose) → old subscription cancelled.

Scanner:
  scan() unchanged: capture → tileIdentifierProvider.identify(bytes) → found(tile)
  identify(): generateContent([Content.multi([TextPart(prompt), InlineDataPart('image/jpeg', bytes)])])
              responseMimeType 'application/json', responseSchema {code: enum of the 37 codes + 'none'}
              → jsonDecode(response.text)['code'] → 'none' or unparsable → null, else Tile.parse(code)
  _ResultSheet(tile) → SenseiPanelWidget(request: SenseiRequest.tileContext(tile), autoStart: true)
  autoStart: ask() once, in initState via a post-frame callback (ConsumerStatefulWidget), never in build.
  « Scanner une autre tuile » → scan() → analysing → sheet slides away → panel disposed → stream cancelled.
```

Network classification `_isNetwork(Object e)`: `e is SocketException`
(`dart:io`; verified, see Context). Everything else (`FirebaseAIException`
and its subtypes, `FirebaseAISdkException`, `FormatException`, …) →
`failed`. Both branches `debugPrint` (M3 lesson: never swallow silently).

The model providers build one `GenerativeModel` each per app run:
`FirebaseAI.googleAI().generativeModel(...)` — App Check is wired
automatically (verified). `systemInstruction: Content.system(_system)`,
`generationConfig` per use (the identifier needs JSON + temperature 0, the
explainer plain text), so **two** model instances: `senseiModelProvider`
(text) and `identifierModelProvider` (JSON). Both `Provider<GenerativeModel>`,
overridden in tests? No: tests override `senseiRepositoryProvider` and
`tileIdentifierProvider` with fakes and never build a model.

## Prompts (private constants in the repository / identifier files, French)

- System (both models): « Tu es un sensei de riichi mahjong, patient et
  précis. Tu réponds en français, en trois phrases au plus, sans markdown,
  sans emoji, sans salutation. »
- `quizMiss`: « Question : {question}. Main : {hand joined by space, codes}.
  Propositions : {A…D}. L'élève a choisi « {options[chosen]} » ; la bonne
  réponse est « {options[correct]} ». Indice de la leçon : {feedback}.
  Explique pourquoi son choix ne convient pas et pourquoi la bonne réponse est
  meilleure, en partant de SON raisonnement. »
- `tileContext`: « Tuile : {tileName} ({tileFamily}). Donne en deux ou trois
  phrases ce qu'un débutant doit savoir sur cette tuile à la table (rôle,
  valeur, piège fréquent). »
- identify (with the photo): « Cette photo montre une tuile de riichi
  mahjong. Réponds par son code : chiffre 1–9 puis m (caractères), p
  (cercles), s (bambous) ; 5mr/5pr/5sr pour un cinq rouge ; 1z–4z vents
  est/sud/ouest/nord ; 5z blanc, 6z vert, 7z rouge ; none si aucune tuile
  nette. » Schema: `Schema.object(properties: {'code': Schema.enumString(enumValues: [...37 codes, 'none'])})`
  (verified). Temperature 0.

## UI

- `SenseiPanelWidget` (`ConsumerStatefulWidget`, public: two consumers):
  `DecoratedBox` `colors.senseiPanel`, `radiusSubPanel`, left `Border(left: BorderSide(colors.senseiRule, 3))`
  (grey `colors.senseiRuleMuted` on failed/offline), padding `space2`.
  Header row: `_Seal` (22×22 `DecoratedBox` `radiusSeal`, `colors.senseiSeal`
  or `senseiSealMuted`, « 先 » `labelSmall` white) + « LE SENSEI »
  `labelMedium` mono uppercase `mutedStrong`. Body by state:
  - `idle`: nothing below the header (the widget is only built once asked,
    except autoStart which asks immediately).
  - `loading`: `_PulsingTiles` (three 11×15 rounded boxes `colors.bambooDeep`,
    one `AnimationController` 1.2 s repeating, each tile an `Interval`-staggered
    `Tween` on `Transform.translate` dy 0→−5 and `Opacity` 0.4→1) + label
    `bodyMedium` « Le sensei regarde votre main » / « … la tuile » (chosen by
    the request variant).
  - `streaming(text)`: `Text.rich` with the text + a `WidgetSpan` `_Cursor`
    (8×15 `colors.bambooDeep`, `AnimationController` 0.9 s, `Interval` with
    `Curves.linear` → opacity 1 for the first half, 0 for the second via a
    `StepTween`).
  - `done(text)`: plain `bodyMedium` text.
  - `failed`: message + `TextButton` « Réessayer » in a white pill
    (`scheme.surface`, `radiusCard`, text `bambooText`) → `ask()`.
  - `offline`: note text only.
- `lesson_screen.dart` `_FeedbackSheet`: on a miss, under the fixed line, a
  `TextButton` « Pourquoi ? » (`bodyMedium` underlined, `mutedStrong`);
  tapping swaps it for `SenseiPanelWidget(request: …, autoStart: true)` —
  simplest: the sheet keeps a `bool _asked` in a small `ConsumerStatefulWidget`
  `_WhyLink`, or watches `senseiProvider(req)` and shows the link while `idle`.
  Choose the second (no widget state, the provider is the truth). The sheet
  needs the request → `_FeedbackSheet` receives `SenseiRequest? whyRequest`
  (null on a hit) built by `_QuizBlockView` from `block` + `session`.
  Sheet height grows; it is `mainAxisSize: .min`, and the quiz body above is
  a `Stack`, so the panel may cover the option grid on small screens — the
  handoff does the same (screen 10). `« Continuer »` unchanged.
- `scanner_screen.dart` `_ResultSheet`: panel between the family line and
  the CTA, `space3` above and below. Sheet stays sized to content.
- Tokens to add: `AppTokens.senseiSealSize = 22`, `senseiRule = 3`,
  `pulseTileWidth = 11`, `pulseTileHeight = 15`, `pulseLift = 5`,
  `pulseDuration = Duration(milliseconds: 1200)`, `cursorWidth = 8`,
  `cursorHeight = 15`, `cursorBlink = Duration(milliseconds: 900)`.
  Colours in `AppColors`: `senseiSeal` (`#B93531` both modes),
  `senseiSealMuted` (`#B5AC9F`), `senseiRule` (bamboo, reuse `bambooDeep`
  if identical), `senseiRuleMuted` (`#B5AC9F`). `senseiPanel` exists.
- French copy verbatim from the handoff; no emoji; no spinner.
